claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The supplied audio reference is a low engine rumble.
The darkness resolves through a faint silhouette into dim ambient light, with the car's bodywork and wheels catching a soft sheen as it advances.

summary.text: A car pulls forward out of near-total darkness, its silhouette resolving into a dimly lit body as a low engine rumble builds and steadies.

description.text: The scene opens in near-total darkness, an unlit space with no readable horizon or surface. A faint, low engine rumble stirs at the edge of hearing while a vague dark mass waits at the centre of the blackness. At first it is only a silhouette: a soft interruption in the darkness, too dim to resolve into panels, wheels, or glass. Around it, the air feels heavy and close, with no visible light source and no detail in the background. The floor is invisible, with only a shallow pool of black suggesting ground beneath. The shape does not move quickly; it holds, barely breathing with the vibration of the engine, and the surrounding black remains unbroken. The only change is the slow emergence of that central mass as the eye adapts, suggesting a car without yet revealing its form.
A low engine rumble grows from near silence, with no other ambience.

The dark mass eases forward and begins to read as a car. Its front end and wheels push into a dim pool of ambient light that catches along the bodywork, revealing a soft sheen on the paint and a faint metallic highlight on the trim. The engine rumble deepens, a steady mechanical pulse under the scene. The car's silhouette sharpens: the slope of the hood, the dark circles of the wheels, the blunt front bumper, and the shadowed cabin become distinct against the surrounding black. The light is low and localized, leaving most of the background in darkness while the car advances slowly, its movement smooth and deliberate. The space around it remains sparse, with only a faint floor reflection beneath the tyres and a thin gradient of grey where the light fades back into black.
The engine rumble deepens into a steady mechanical pulse.

The car continues rolling forward, now fully clear of the darkness. More of its body fills the view as it advances into the foreground: the front grille, the broad hood, and the turning wheels are readable, while the cabin recedes into a softer shadow. The engine rumble stays low and steady, a continuous mechanical drone that matches the car's slow, purposeful motion. Behind it, the surrounding dark falls away, leaving only a narrow halo of dim ambient light around the bodywork and a faint sheen along the roof and side panels. The tyres roll over an unseen surface, their motion slow and even. The car's movement is steady and deliberate, its mass growing more dominant as it closes the distance, until the dark background is almost entirely behind it.
The engine settles into a low, continuous mechanical drone.

soundscape: A low, dark engine rumble with a steady mechanical pulse, building out of near silence and settling into a continuous drone.
